surfaces.title: Model execution
surfaces.summary: PSS deliberately uses AI SDK language-model objects and its generate/stream APIs instead of Pi’s @earendil-works/pi-ai provider and model stack.

surfaces.title: Execution continuity
surfaces.summary: PSS deliberately owns durable thread state, lease-fenced run transitions, checkpoints, replay cursors, and cross-process recovery behind runtime-neutral AgentHost ports instead of adopting Pi Durable’s Chord document and SQLite session engine.

surfaces.title: Terminal UI
surfaces.summary: The coding agent adapts Pi’s TUI package behind PSS-owned application and rendering boundaries.

surfaces.title: Workspace coding tools
surfaces.summary: PSS implements its own read, write, edit, grep, find, and command-execution tools.

surfaces.title: Interactive CLI
surfaces.summary: PSS provides an independently implemented interactive terminal entry point and command set.

surfaces.title: Headless CLI
surfaces.summary: PSS provides its own non-interactive exec runner corresponding to Pi print and JSON automation use cases.

surfaces.title: Thread persistence
surfaces.summary: PSS owns keyed thread history, storage contracts, event records, and compaction across memory, file, Durable Object, and SQL/queue hosts.

surfaces.title: Extension API
surfaces.summary: PSS maps Pi-style customization goals onto a capability-based extension host with explicit lifecycle and service boundaries.

surfaces.title: Model selection
surfaces.summary: PSS exposes model catalog selection through an OpenAI-compatible provider adapter rather than Pi’s built-in provider registry.

surfaces.title: SDK and embedding
surfaces.summary: PSS exposes its own public createCodingAgent and createAgent APIs for embedding durable agent sessions in applications.

surfaces.title: RPC integration
surfaces.summary: PSS supplies app-owned worker RPC, JSONL protocol transport, and remote TUI delivery instead of Pi’s stdio RPC protocol.

surfaces.title: Skills
surfaces.summary: PSS discovers SKILL.md resources and exposes them on demand through PSS-owned trust, source-precedence, and workspace boundaries.

surfaces.title: Prompt templates
surfaces.summary: PSS discovers and expands Markdown prompt templates through PSS-owned directories, trust rules, and command integration.

surfaces.title: Themes
surfaces.summary: Pi-compatible user theme packages are not part of the pinned PSS surface.

surfaces.title: Pi packages
surfaces.summary: Installing Pi package bundles is not a compatibility goal of the pinned PSS release; PSS has its own managed extension format.
